external_interruption_recovery_proposal.model_failure: OOM or model exception is a genuine failed attempt, even if later worker exits; no retry/fallback under current policy
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.external_evidence: Scheduler/preemption/host-reboot/signal evidence independent of model performance; transport disconnection alone does not prove worker stopped. Unknown cause remains unknown, not relabeled external. SIGKILL alone is insufficient: host/kernel OOM or resource-limit termination is not verified external interruption; record the actual cause or UNKNOWN_CAUSE.
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.committed_outputs: Reuse only hash-bound, schema-valid atomically committed packet plus ledger receipt. A completed output after disconnect is not recomputed. Content-complete orphan packet may be reattached only after read-only identity/checksum reconciliation; no model invocation.
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.partial_outputs: Preserve attempt-local temporary/partial output and diagnostics; never expose it as committed prediction or overwrite it
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.extra_attempt: Re-executing interrupted in-flight uncommitted work is an additional attempt requiring explicit recovery approval; it is not the same as continuing never-attempted work
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.commit_protocol_proposed: Write attempt-unique temporary file on same filesystem, flush/fsync as appropriate, atomic rename to immutable content-addressed packet, then append durable ledger receipt; recover crash window by reconciliation, not inference
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.history: Append attempt_id, parent_attempt_id, start/end, process status, interruption proof, hashes, disposition and recovery decision. Preserve all failed/external attempts. Conflicting valid outputs for same frozen work ID stop reconciliation; never select better score.
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.strict_complete_after_recovery: Only if explicit policy/continuation acceptance permits external recovery and all fixed required work reconciles to one accepted valid packet. Genuine failed work remains INCOMPLETE under zero-model-retry policy. This proposal does not retroactively change closed CPI results.
external_interruption_recovery_proposal.caps: Recovery does not reset per-system storage/resource caps or authorize unlimited attempts; extra cost remains reported

selection.eligible: accepted fixed task/support bindings + strict-complete quality; report runtime eligibility independently
selection.absolute_floor_reason: No application-validated threshold supplied; relative public checkpoint selection, not deployment acceptance
selection.near_tie_units: absolute0-1 metric difference =0.5 percentage points; proposed descriptive margin, not equivalence
selection.uncertainty: 1000 paired cluster bootstrap resamples by known exact decoded-RGB duplicate groups; fixed seed20261021; descriptive95percent interval, no independence claim for unobserved near duplicates
selection.rule: Within each task/route select best Q, report instance F1/FP, flag near ties, retain non-dominated Q/instance-F1/route-latency/device-sampled-memory configurations; no weighted score or forced universal winner
selection.practical_near_tie_definition: abs(point_estimate_Q_A - point_estimate_Q_B) <= 0.005; independent of uncertainty interval
selection.uncertainty_zero_crossing_definition: paired difference interval includes0; labels direction inconclusive under this interval only; neither practical tie nor equivalence follows
selection.per_class_regression_policy: Remove undefined no-important-per-class-regression automatic rule. Publish all supported per-class deltas and support; no post-hoc veto/floor. Any mandatory class minima or regression tolerance needs explicit pre-score design acceptance and a versioned selection rule.
selection.near_tie_action: Report descriptive flag and resource trade-offs; do not automatically replace quality leader by fastest model. Retain non-dominated same-task/route configurations; if practical near-ties have conflicting class/resource trade-offs report multiple suitable configurations.
selection.C3_selection_role: Ranks garment projection quality for upper/lower/shoes among proposed configurations, not proof of body/accessory sufficiency or native-taxonomy superiority.
selection.C7_selection_role: Separate joint body/clothing selection among CIHP-compatible configurations; no cross-C3/C7 score pooling. Sapiens body proxy is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy mandatory body capability via C3 score.
selection.mandatory_capability_status: USER_DECISION_PENDING: named body regions and named accessories; body interest is confirmed but exact mandatory subset and quality floor are not accepted
selection.final_selection_gate: Without accepted mandatory capability profile, issue conditional C3/C7 shortlists and Pareto alternatives only; do not declare a universal downstream winner or infer CCTV readiness.

resource_caps_proposed.OOM: record failure; do not change precision/resolution/TTA to finish same run
resource_caps_proposed.per_system_accounting: Each checkpoint inference stream owns unique physical artifacts once, including associated/native views; shared references do not duplicate bytes. Existing immutable artifacts are baseline occupied disk, not newly allocated output; free-space guard covers total filesystem use.
resource_caps_proposed.cap_coverage: 80 GiB proposed per-checkpoint stream includes its retained packets, attempt logs, temps/cache and attributable new artifacts. Shared new artifacts are charged once in a shared ledger and count toward aggregate capacity; no hidden double-counting or uncharged temporary disk.
resource_caps_proposed.aggregate_feasibility: 7*80=560 GiB potential independent per-stream ceilings exceed planning reserve200 GiB; 200 is not evidence full workload fits. B must estimate aggregate peak and allocate capacity before launch.
resource_caps_proposed.admission_proposal: If retaining the200 GiB planning envelope, require at least250 GiB free at launch (200 plus untouchable50) and a measured B aggregate peak compatible with available capacity. This does not reserve filesystem blocks against other users.
resource_caps_proposed.stop_policy: Stop scheduling before estimated next atomic write/temporary peak would breach free50 GiB or owning stream80 GiB; if already below minimum stop immediately/safely preserve outputs. Reaching200 GiB alone is not a global hard stop. Re-estimate capacity and obtain resource decision if B cannot support planned envelope; never delete evidence to continue.
B_measurements: serialized per-frame/ROI/native-person artifact bytes and native count distribution
native/final view reuse versus genuine copies and compression observed, not assumed
metadata/log/attempt/cache growth and shared artifact accounting
peak temporary plus atomic write scratch and retained-output accumulation
disk headroom under other users, co-resident T4 memory and clean route times; ETA only after suitable evidence
